text: The major closely follows the development trends of the discipline, taking information technology as a support. It is featured with electricity network control for the carrier and network control. It is designed to train professionals capable of engineering design, system analysis, system operation, management and decision-making work or various Electric (electrical) the research and development of automation equipment in the field of electrical engineering, power electronics technology, power detection and automated instrumentation, motion control, industrial process control, electronics and computer technology. The main features of the major lies in that it combines electrical engineering with automation, strong electricity with weak electricity, electrical technology with electronic technology, and software with hardware. It focuses its training on electrical engineering, power electronics, power line carrier and automation. Targeted to the power industry and its relevant industries, it has great market demand for talents in all sectors of the national economy.
